properties.description: Metadata-driven incremental load. Reads the active watermark table list and fans out PL_Raw_Data_Ingestion for every source table in parallel (ForEach), implementing the watermark + change-tracking pattern.

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT SourceSchema, SourceTable FROM ctl.WatermarkControl WHERE IsActive = 1

properties._change_tracking_note: For sources with SQL Server Change Tracking enabled, replace the ModifiedDate predicate in PL_Raw_Data_Ingestion's source query with: SELECT t.*, ct.SYS_CHANGE_OPERATION FROM dbo.Trips t JOIN CHANGETABLE(CHANGES dbo.Trips, @{activity('Lookup Watermark').output.firstRow.LastWatermarkValue}) ct ON t.TripID = ct.TripID  -- this captures I/U/D operations for true CDC semantics instead of a ModifiedDate delta.
